sections.title: Direct-to-cell satellite companies
sections.intro: The companies building satellites that talk to ordinary phones, or that sit close to that market.

spacex-launches.label: SpaceX: launches
spacex-launches.why: SpaceX's own schedule and mission pages for Falcon 9 and Starship, the first place a launch date shows up.

spacex-starship.label: SpaceX: Starship
spacex-starship.why: Vehicle overview for the rocket behind our Starship explainers.

spacex-flight15.label: SpaceX: Starship Flight 15
spacex-flight15.why: SpaceX's own page for the flight our explainers are based on.

starlink.label: Starlink
starlink.why: Starlink's home page: broadband, business and mobile services.

starlink-mobile.label: Starlink Mobile
starlink-mobile.why: Starlink's own description of its direct-to-cell service for ordinary phones.

blue-origin.label: Blue Origin: New Glenn
blue-origin.why: Official page for New Glenn, Blue Origin's heavy-lift rocket.

rocket-lab.label: Rocket Lab: Electron
rocket-lab.why: Official page for Electron, a small rocket used for dedicated small-satellite launches.

ula.label: United Launch Alliance
ula.why: Home of Vulcan and Atlas V, rockets used for Amazon Leo launches.

ast.label: AST SpaceMobile
ast.why: The BlueBird satellite builder and operator: how its network is meant to work and who its partners are.

ast-investors.label: AST SpaceMobile: investor relations
ast-investors.why: Quarterly updates, filings and presentations, where launch timelines and satellite counts are first stated.

elveo.label: Elveo (formerly Lynk)
elveo.why: Lynk's old web address now redirects here. Elveo describes itself as a direct-to-device company formed from Lynk and Omnispace.

skylo.label: Skylo
skylo.why: Satellite messaging for phones and devices, supplied through partner carriers and device makers.

globalstar.label: Globalstar
globalstar.why: Operator of the satellite network behind Apple's satellite features on iPhone.

iridium.label: Iridium
iridium.why: Satellite operator that has announced a standards-based (3GPP NTN) direct-to-device service.

amazon-leo.label: Amazon Leo
amazon-leo.why: Amazon's official page for its Leo constellation, formerly known as Project Kuiper.

eutelsat.label: Eutelsat OneWeb
eutelsat.why: Eutelsat runs the OneWeb low-orbit network; the old oneweb.net address redirects here.

apple-satellite.label: Apple Support: connect to a satellite
apple-satellite.why: Apple's own guide to Emergency SOS and messaging via satellite on iPhone 14 and later.

tmobile.label: T-Mobile: T-Satellite
tmobile.why: Plans, supported phones and coverage for T-Mobile's satellite service in the US.

vmo2.label: O2: O2 Satellite
vmo2.why: The UK's first direct-to-device service: price, phones and how it works, from the operator.

vodafone-sce.label: Vodafone: Satellite Connect Europe
vodafone-sce.why: Vodafone's announcement of Satellite Connect Europe, the European direct-to-device venture between Vodafone and AST SpaceMobile.

att-ast.label: AT&T: AST SpaceMobile handoff
att-ast.why: AT&T's account of its first handoff between a ground network and AST's satellites (2 Nov 2026). A trial, not a commercial service.

rogers.label: Rogers: Rogers Satellite
rogers.why: Canada's Starlink-based satellite texting service and the apps it supports.

one-nz.label: One NZ: satellite data and calling
one-nz.why: One NZ's announcement of data, app and calling support on its satellite service.

telstra.label: Telstra: satellite to mobile apps
telstra.why: Telstra's explanation of the satellite apps available on its satellite-to-mobile service.

kddi.label: KDDI: au Starlink Direct
kddi.why: KDDI's English newsroom on au Starlink Direct, its direct-to-cell service in Japan.

rakuten.label: Rakuten Mobile: AST SpaceMobile video call
rakuten.why: Rakuten Mobile's press release on its first video call over AST SpaceMobile's satellites. A trial, not a commercial service.

orange.label: Orange: satellite SMS
orange.why: Orange's announcement of a satellite SMS service in France, and the first of its kind from a European operator.

ofcom-space.label: Ofcom: space and satellites
ofcom-space.why: The UK regulator's hub for satellite licensing, spectrum decisions and consultations.

ofcom-d2d.label: Ofcom: enabling satellite direct to device services
ofcom-d2d.why: The statement and regulations that let UK phones connect to satellite services in mobile spectrum bands.

ofcom-switchoff.label: Ofcom: switching off 2G and 3G
ofcom-switchoff.why: What the UK 3G and 2G switch-offs mean for customers, with operator timetables.

ofcom-abroad.label: Ofcom: using your mobile abroad
ofcom-abroad.why: The UK regulator's plain guide to roaming charges and alerts when you travel.

fcc-scs.label: FCC: supplemental coverage from space
fcc-scs.why: The March 2024 FCC order that created the US framework for satellite-to-phone service.

fcc-rules.label: eCFR: 47 CFR 25.125, SCS applications
fcc-rules.why: The current text of the FCC rule that governs applications for supplemental coverage from space.

itu-r.label: ITU Radiocommunication Sector: space services
itu-r.why: The UN body that coordinates satellite orbits and radio spectrum between countries.

3gpp-ntn.label: 3GPP: non-terrestrial networks
3gpp-ntn.why: The standards body's overview of how satellites fit into 5G and LTE, which is what lets one phone work on both.

gsma-ntn.label: GSMA: non-terrestrial networks community
gsma-ntn.why: The mobile industry body's group for joining up mobile and satellite networks.

mcdowell-starlink.label: Jonathan McDowell: Starlink statistics
mcdowell-starlink.why: The independent satellite count we use for Starlink, including its direct-to-cell shells.

mcdowell-leo.label: Jonathan McDowell: Amazon Leo statistics
mcdowell-leo.why: Launched and working Amazon Leo (Kuiper) satellites.

mcdowell-jsr.label: Jonathan's Space Report
mcdowell-jsr.why: Long-running independent record of launches and orbital activity.

celestrak.label: CelesTrak
celestrak.why: Public orbital data for tracking where satellites are right now.

next-spaceflight.label: Next Spaceflight
next-spaceflight.why: Independent launch calendar across all providers.

launch-library.label: The Space Devs: Launch Library 2
launch-library.why: The open launch database behind our launch tracker.

opensignal.label: Opensignal
opensignal.why: Real-world measurements from phones, including analysis of satellite connections.

ookla-d2d.label: Ookla: direct-to-device comes of age in APAC
ookla-d2d.why: Speed-test data on how direct-to-device services perform in Asia-Pacific.

grok.label: Grok
grok.why: xAI's assistant, if you want to ask questions about what you read here.
